description: The plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for different model ensembles. The x-axis is labeled “Cost” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10 with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled “Reliability Score” and has a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90 with tick labels at intervals of 10. A blue line, representing the “3-Model Ensemble”, begins at approximately (0, 89) and declines to approximately (10, 73) with a relatively steady decrease. A red line, representing the “2-Model Ensemble”, starts at approximately (0, 86) and declines to approximately (10, 75), also with a relatively steady decrease. An orange line, representing a third ensemble, begins at approximately (0, 82) and declines to approximately (10, 36), with a more pronounced decrease, passing through approximately (4, 68) and (8, 50).
